race.comment: UNCOMMON MIND (3) has the clearest recent form after finishing third at this track over 1350m, beaten a length and a half, following a fourth here when she charged home from well back. Strips fitter third-up and with the claimer sticking she can get off the mark. OFFA'S DYKE (1) was no match for an impressive maiden winner here last time but still did a good job to hold second. Has placed twice around this distance and with Murtagh sticking he rates a major threat. HAMMERTIME (8) returns from a short break and makes her stable debut for the Brown camp. Was okay when finishing fourth at Nowra on soft ground before the break and a recent Port Lincoln trial should have her forward enough. Can play a role. SOCIAL STORM (5) resumes in fresh colours and looks best of the rest.
